requirements.general_text: Any one of these: Bachelor's Degree in Science (Tier 1): With CGPA equal or more than 2.75 with research project component in related field or 2 years working experience in Science related industry Bachelor's Degree in Science (Tier 2): With CGPA less than 2.75 but more than 2.50, candidates will be subject to rigorous internal assessment Bachelor's Degree in Science (Tier 3): With a CGPA less than 2.50 but more than 2.00, recognised by the Malaysian or National Government, AND a minimum of 5 years related working experience Other Qualifications: Any other equivalent qualification recognised by the Malaysian Government or accepted by the Taylor's University Senate, AND any of the above conditions would require student's research proposal to be approved English Requirement (International Students) IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 60 (Internet Based Test) (May join IEN preparatory course and achieve the IELTS score)
